name: edit-take
description: Fixes one thing in a Suno take without re-rolling the song - a word or a line, a cut or added line, a time range redone, an instrument added or dropped - and keeps the rest of the take's audio; also makes an instrumental version of a take. Shows the cost and waits for a go-ahead.
